metadata.reason: Original 10k control observed zero severe weeks; independent fixed 100k control avoids relying on that under-sampled tail

environment.failure_distribution: Periodic hazard: 70% intensity in one day/week; 30% in other six days; integral rate 1/30 days
environment.initial_clocks: Each initially healthy machine draws an independent Uniform(0,7d) fixed window phase
environment.new_node_clocks: Independent new phase for each new VM; recoveries retain the existing machine phase
environment.metric: Full-week time-average, including continuation after early data-loss returns

metadata.sampling: Independent fixed sample; disjoint seeds 317000000 through 317099999; no adaptive stopping
